decisions.statement: An empty set of personas is an error rather than a cast of nobody.
Personas come back sorted by slug.
A portrait named with no file beside the page raises an error.
The domain a persona champions reads back to her slug.
A domain and a role read back as the slug alone, whatever page type names it.
A display name is the slug with its first letter upper case.
A last message time longer than twenty-four characters is refused.

definition: persona pages read back as who she is, with her portrait file, and her last message time kept
